# New Blossom Hotel & Spa

> A sanctuary of restorative calm and botanical luxury in Dire Dawa, Ethiopia. Spa, hammam, suites, dining, and wellness retreats rooted in Ethiopian healing traditions.

New Blossom Hotel & Spa is a boutique hotel and wellness retreat located on Ratu Road in Dire Dawa, Ethiopia. Founded around Ethiopian botanical healing traditions, the hotel offers 16 signature spa rituals, a traditional hammam, luxury suites and rooms, a garden restaurant, courtyard terrace dining, an executive lounge for private events, and curated heritage excursions across Dire Dawa and the Harar region.

## Key Information

- **Location:** Ratu Road, Dire Dawa, Ethiopia
- **Coordinates:** 9.5908°N, 41.8662°E
- **Phone:** +251 25 111 4000
- **Email:** concierge@newblossomdiredawa.com
- **Languages:** English, Amharic (አማርኛ)
- **Check-in:** 2:00 PM | **Check-out:** 12:00 PM
- **Rating:** 3.5 stars · 116 reviews

## Services & Amenities

- Botanical Spa & Hammam (16 signature rituals)
- Luxury Suites & Rooms (Royal Blossom Suite, Deluxe Garden Room)
- Garden Restaurant & Courtyard Terrace (7 AM – 11 PM daily)
- Executive Lounge & Salon (private events, conferences up to 80 guests)
- Wellness Retreat Packages (3, 5, and 7-day programs)
- 360° Virtual Tour
- Heritage Excursions (Chemin de Fer, Kezira Architecture, Spice Markets, Harar Coffee Trail)
- Free WiFi, Free Parking, 24h Security, Room Service, Airport Pickup

## Notable

- Host to CCRDA advocacy workshops and Awash Bank business development training
- Uses indigenous Ethiopian botanicals: frankincense, myrrh, mountain thyme (Tosign), acacia honey, Harar coffee
- Traditional Ethiopian hammam with mineral-rich steam and kessa glove exfoliation
- Located near Dire Dawa railway station (1902), Kezira French colonial district, and Harar Jugol (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
